answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 24987 Country: India Title: Can a Muslim woman read Ayatul Kursi and the 4 Quls ( Kaafiroon , Ikhalas, Al -Falaq & An naas) while she is menstruating as a form of duaa for her protection and not as a form of tilaawat ? Please clarify. Question: Can a Muslim woman read Ayatul Kursi and the 4 Quls ( Kaafiroon , Ikhalas, Al -Falaq & An naas) while she is menstruating as a form of duaa for her protection and not as a form of tilaawat ? Please clarify. Answer ID: 24987 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1377/1377/M =1431) A menstruating woman can recite ayatul kursi and four Quls as dua. So is mentioned in the book of fiqh and fatawa . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
